item.title: Imagining the Imaginary: A Cultural-Intellectual History of the Complex Plane (1748--2025)
item.description: A cultural-intellectual history of the complex plane (1748–2025): from Euler’s symbolic i to Argand diagrams, modern physics, computation, and the aesthetics of fractals.

item.title: Number Theory from Euler to Today (Europe & the United States): A Research Report
item.description: A research-report style history of number theory from Euler to the present, tracing the interplay of algebra, analysis, geometry, probability, and computation, and highlighting key results from quadratic reciprocity and Dirichlet’s theorem through modern cryptography-adjacent and “structure vs randomness” perspectives.
